name: Chalkboard Maths
tagline: 3Blue1Brown lesson: deep navy board, mono labels, one colour per meaning, dim and reveal.

motion.direction: A 3Blue1Brown lesson. Mono text, one colour per meaning for the whole reel: `gold` yellow is the active term, `goldd` teal the definition, `ter` red the warning, `iv` the statement. One equation or claim on the board at a time (`equation`, `posterText` of 2–6 words in sentence case), written in over ~1 s then held 2–3 s; the previous one fades when the next writes. `counter`s as live readouts in the parameter's own colour. `chapterCard`s as section cards (number in `gold`). `strikeLine` through the wrong intuition. Start sparse (one element), build density toward the end. Still camera, `card` mode most of the time so the board shows. No slams, stamps, punch-ins, patterns or photo bleeds.
